title: RelationshipFacts
description: Registry's ONLY answer about actor-to-subject linkage. Deliberately narrower than ScopeFacts: keeping this type minimal is what stops modules growing a hidden dependency on Registry internals, and what prevents a recursive Access-to-Registry authorisation call. Extended additively in M01 with school_id, the plural section_ids/subject_ids, and valid_until.

school_id.description: Present so a caller can detect a cross-school answer without a second lookup.

section_ids.description: All sections the relationship covers. Always contains section_id when that is set.

subject_ids.description: All subject offerings the relationship covers.

valid_until.description: Last date the relationship is in force. Null means open-ended. A lapsed relationship must not authorise a read.
